text: {"found":true,"quote":"This form of the equation (y = b + mx) indicates that by plotting Rt on the y-axis (on a logarithmic scale) against porosity (phi) on the x-axis (on a logarithmic scale), one can determine the product (a * Rw) from intercept of the line (b), and the cementation exponent (m) from the slope of the line (m).","page_pdf":132}
